family.description: ssDNA-binding protein from Enterobacter phage Enc34 ([swissprot:H6WYG2]) shows a globular shape with a mixed alpha/beta architecture consisting mainly of beta-strands that clearly resembles the oligosaccharide/ oligonucleotide-binding (OB)-fold [[cite:PUB00100680]]. The characteristics of the protein distribution suggest prophage matches in addition to the phage matches.
family.name: Enterobacter phage Enc34, ssDNA-binding protein
